parts.1: 📌 Future Continuous zamoni: Kelajakdagi davomli harakatlar (1/5-qism) 💡 Future Continuous zamoni kelajakdagi ma'lum bir vaqtda davom etayotgan bo'ladigan harakatlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Bu zamon yordamida biz kelajakdagi aniq bir fursatda aynan nima ish bilan mashg'ul bo'lishimizni tasvirlaymiz. O'zbek tiliga bu shakl ko'pincha qilayotgan bo'laman yoki bajarayotgan bo'ladi deb tarjima qilinadi. Bunda asosiy e'tibor harakatning shunchaki sodir bo'lishiga emas, balki aynan o'sha vaqtdagi davomiyligiga qaratiladi. 📖 Misollarga e'tibor bering: • Tomorrow at 5 PM, I will be playing football. (Ertaga soat 5 da men futbol o'ynayotgan bo'laman.) • At this time next week, we will be flying to London. (Keyingi hafta xuddi shu vaqtda biz Londonga uchayotgan bo'lamiz.) 📝 Seriyamizning keyingi qismlarida ushbu zamonda darak, inkor va so'roq gaplarni to'g'ri tuzish qoidalarini birma-bir ko'rib chiqamiz. Kanalni kuzatib boring!
parts.2: 📌 Future Continuous: Darak gap shakli (2/5) 📖 Bugungi darsimizda Future Continuous zamonida darak gaplar tuzish tartibini batafsil ko'rib chiqamiz. ⚙️ Darak gap formulasi: Subject + will be + V-ing 🗣️ Misollar: 🔹 I will be working at 8 o'clock tomorrow evening. (Ertaga kechqurun soat 8 da men ishlayotgan bo'laman.) 🔹 She will be cooking dinner when you arrive home. (Siz uyga yetib kelganingizda u kechki ovqatni pishirayotgan bo'ladi.) 🔹 They will be traveling across Europe next month. (Keyingi oyda ular Yevropa bo'ylab sayohat qilayotgan bo'lishadi.) 🔹 At this time tomorrow, we will be swimming in the ocean. (Ertaga shu vaqtda biz okeanda cho'milayotgan bo'lamiz.) ❗ Muhim eslatma: Eng ko'p uchraydigan xato — be fe'lini tushirib qoldirishdir. Masalan, "I will working" deyish grammatik jihatdan noto'g'ri. Har doim will be birga ishlatilishi va asosiy fe'lga -ing qo me'yorida qo'shilishi shart!
parts.3: 📌 Future Continuous: Inkor shakli (3/5) 💡 Kelajakda ma'lum bir vaqtda davom etmayotgan harakatni ifodalash uchun Future Continuous zamonining inkor shakli ishlatiladi. 🔤 Formula: Subject + will not (won't) + be + V-ing 📝 Misollar: • I won't be sleeping at 10 PM tonight. (Bugun tunda soat 10 da men uxlamayotgan bo'laman.) • She will not be working this time tomorrow. (Ertaga shu vaqtda u ishlamayotgan bo'ladi.) • We won't be watching TV when you arrive. (Siz kelganingizda biz televizor ko'rmayotgan bo'lamiz.) • They won't be playing football at 5 o'clock. (Soat 5 da ular futbol o'ynamayotgan bo'lishadi.) ❗ Muhim eslatma: Inkor shaklida not yuklamasi har doim will fe'lidan keyin joylashadi. Will be not deyish grammatik xatodir. Har doim will not be yoki qisqartmasi won't be ko'rinishida ishlating.
parts.4: 📌 Future Continuous: So'roq gaplar (4/5-qism) 💡 Umumiy so'roq gaplar (Yes/No questions) Will + egasi + be + V-ing ... ? ❓ Maxsus so'roq gaplar (Wh- questions) Wh-so'z + will + egasi + be + V-ing ... ? 📖 Misollar: • Will you be sleeping at 11 PM tonight? (Bugun tunda soat 11 da uxlayotgan bo'lasanmi?) • Will she be working at this time tomorrow? (Ertaga shu vaqtda u ishlayotgan bo'ladimi?) • What will you be doing tomorrow at 5 o'clock? (Ertaga soat 5 da nima qilayotgan bo'lasan?) • Where will they be staying during the conference? (Konferensiya davomida ular qayerda yashayotgan bo'lishadi?) 📝 Eslatma: Umumiy so'roq gaplarga qisqa javob berganda "Yes, I will" yoki "No, I won't" deyish yetarli. Qisqa javobda be hamda -ing qo'shimchasi qayta ishlatilmaydi.
parts.5: 📝 Future Continuous: Amaliyot (5/5-qism) 📌 Ko'p yo'l qo'yiladigan xatolar: 1. Holat fe'llari (Stative verbs) bilan Continuous ishlatish. Masalan, I will be knowing deyish xato, to'g'risi: I will know. 2. Aniq vaqt ko'rsatilmagan oddiy harakatlar uchun bu zamonni qo'llash. Shunchaki kelajakdagi harakat uchun Future Continuous emas, Future Simple ishlatiladi. 📝 Bo'sh joylarni to'ldiring: 1. Tomorrow at 5 PM, I ___ (play) football with my friends. 2. Don't phone me at 9 PM. I ___ (study) for my exam. 3. This time next week, we ___ (relax) on the beach. 4. At 8 o'clock tomorrow morning, they ___ (not / work). ✅ Javoblar: 1. will be playing — kelajakda aniq ko'rsatilgan vaqtdagi jarayon. 2. will be studying — aytilgan vaqtda band bo'lish holati. 3. will be relaxing — kelajakdagi ma'lum bir paytdagi davomiy harakat. 4. will not be working (yoki won't be working) — inkor shaklidagi jarayon.
